## 問題
2025 年第二季所有物流商合計的平均配送天數？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 語意層無對應項目，改以資料庫直接判斷。以 shipments.shipped_ts 落在 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 作為第二季範圍，配送天數為 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts（以 julianday 計算日數），排除 delivered_ts 為 NULL 的 4,870 筆未送達紀錄中的未完成部分。共納入 9,947 筆已送達出貨單，所有物流商合併計算，平均 2.91 天。
SQL 1: ["SELECT s.shipment_id, s.order_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(delivered_ts IS NULL) AS null_delivered, SUM(shipped_ts IS NULL) AS null_shipped, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_shipped FROM shipments"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT s.shipment_id, s.order_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10', 'columns': ['shipment_id', 'order_id', 'carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts', 'order_ts'], 'rows': [[1, 1, 'post', '2025-05-29
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL
  結果: {'columns': ['n', 'avg_delivery_days', 'min_days', 'max_days'], 'rows': [[9947, 2.91, 0.625, 7.083333333488554]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層的時區規則，將 orders.order_ts（UTC）加 8 小時換算為台北時間後，篩選 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 的訂單。配送天數定義為 shipments.delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts（以天為單位），排除任一時間為空的紀錄，共 9,921 筆；所有訂單時間皆可解析，且無 delivered 早於 shipped 的紀錄。
SQL 1: SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments LIMIT 10
  結果: {'columns': ['shipment_id', 'order_id', 'carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts'], 'rows': [[1, 1, 'post', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03 18:32:55'], [2, 2, 'blackcat', '2025-06-03 17:04:51', '2025-06-06 13:04:51'], [3, 3, 'hct', '2025-09-28 09:46:07', '2025-09-29 19:46:07'], [4, 4, 'blackcat', '
SQL 2: ["SELECT o.order_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, s.carrier FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_ts IS NULL OR delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_ts, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reversed, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders FROM shipments"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT o.order_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, s.carrier FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 10', 'columns': ['order_id', 'order_ts', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts', 'carrier'], 'rows': [[1, '2025-05-27 02:32:55', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03
SQL 3: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  結果: {'columns': ['n', 'avg_delivery_days'], 'rows': [[9921, 2.91]], 'truncated': False}
SQL 4: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_joined, SUM(CASE WHEN datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unparsed_ts FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL
  結果: {'columns': ['total_joined', 'unparsed_ts'], 'rows': [[39574, 0]], 'truncated': False}
raw: {"winner": "B", "reason": "兩者答案同為 2.91，但 B 依語意層規則把 UTC 時間換算為台北時間再界定第二季，並檢查了空值、時間倒置與時間可解析性，驗證較完整；A 直接用未換算時區的 shipped_ts 篩選，排除未送達紀錄的描述也含糊，嚴謹度較低。", "critical_error": false}
